notes: The מִן … עַד range writes a waw immediately before the limit preposition and the ASV writes even to, so the waw takes even and the עַד takes the relational word alone (rule 16's counting sentence, with rules 14 and 26).
לְנָבִיא takes the to be frame as its resultative rendering, headed on to (rule 49); the following לַיהוָה keeps the of written for it.
